text_block_list.text: Fine Motion and I are drinking some tea while we have a meeting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm, where's the sugar? Ah! Here it is! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So then, Trainer, about our training regimen…
choice_data_list: (That… was a lot of sugar cubes.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What do you think about making some changes based on my race results? I personally believe flexibility is key.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's decided then! ♪ Okay, I'm going to give it my all tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion doesn't let her fatigue show, but it might be the reason she's craving all that sugar. I might want to take another look at her race schedule.
